title: DriveAlign structured driving output contract v3
description: Single-image driving scene analysis output contract. Changes from v1: (1) coarse_position removed from the generation contract and derived by the parser from bbox_2d plus image size; (2) category closed over the nuScenes detection class set, canonical terms in configs/contracts/v3/category_vocab.json; (3) risk_factors closed over configs/contracts/v3/risk_taxonomy.json; (4) behavior replaced by motion_state enum defined in configs/contracts/v3/motion_vocab.json; (5) critical_objects capped at 8 items; (6) risk_factors must be unique. bbox_2d is [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in absolute input-image pixel coordinates, origin top-left. Open-vocabulary model results are normalized by the versioned synonym tables; unmapped terms are recorded, never silently repaired.

critical_objects.description: Objects relevant to the current driving decision. Empty list allowed. Hard cap of 8 items keeps token length and scoring deterministic.

risk_factors.description: Closed risk taxonomy; each item must be a canonical term from configs/contracts/v3/risk_taxonomy.json (synonyms are normalized by the parser before validation). Empty list allowed; duplicates not allowed.

reasoning.description: Concise explanation grounded in the current image and the available ego speed, if provided. Free text by design: never scored for content, format constraint only.

yield_required.description: True when the ego vehicle should yield to another road user or situation.

speed_action.description: Requested speed control action. Ground truth for evaluation is derived from future physics by the M09 oracle.

category.description: Canonical category from the nuScenes detection class set; synonyms normalized via configs/contracts/v3/category_vocab.json.

bbox_2d.description: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in absolute input-image pixel coordinates, origin top-left. Corner-order and image-bounds checks are applied by the parser as semantic validation.

motion_state.description: Coarse motion state; ground truth derivable from nuScenes box velocity relative to ego. Canonical values defined in configs/contracts/v3/motion_vocab.json.
